method: Manual reading of Hostinger's public coupon page and selected VPS tab in the original Chrome browser; no checkout or redemption test.
http_status_note: The browser observation did not expose an origin response status; none is inferred.
currency_evidence: US English page view; the cards use $ and the page footer states prices are listed without VAT.

web_hosting.payment_wording: All plans are paid upfront. The monthly rate reflects the total plan price divided by the number of months in your plan.

coupon_faq.existing_customers: Discount codes may be used when ordering new hosting plans; renewal discounts are accessed through hPanel.
coupon_faq.deadline: No exact deadline shown on the observed cards.

vps.deadline: No exact deadline shown on the observed VPS cards.

scope: Current public-page observations only. The cards do not establish account-specific eligibility, checkout acceptance, or the next renewal invoice total. The VPS card observation does not establish its initial term or prepaid total.
